newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's o/n rates end steady at 21 percent.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's o/n rates end steady at 21 percent.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest rates finished steady on Tuesday after trading below Friday's closing level, dealers said.
The overnight rates closed at 21 percent, unchanged from Friday, after trading between 20.625 and 21.00 percent.
Monday was a market holiday in Hungary.
Traders said overnight rates were likely to stay around current levels for the next few days.
"We see no reason for a substantial change," said Pal Szucs of Hypo-Bank Hungaria.
